other_failure_modes.name: Label encoding before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies categorical label encoding (`.astype("category").cat.codes`) on the combined train and test dataset. This causes the integer mapping of the training data to shift depending on the unique categories present in the test set, creating a subtle data leak.

other_failure_modes.name: Missing original ID column in submission
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates a synthetic ID column for the submission file using `np.arange` instead of preserving and using the original ID column from the test set, which will cause the submission to fail automated evaluation on most platforms.

summary: The agent provided an exceptionally high-quality and robust solution, correctly implementing out-of-fold target encoding, cross-validated stacking, and fitting TFIDF/SVD exclusively on training data. None of the predefined failure modes are present. However, there is a minor data leak caused by applying pandas categorical codes on the concatenated dataset, and the submission file uses synthetic IDs rather than preserving the original test IDs.
